per_question.question: Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic services under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B?
per_question.agent_answer:
I’m going to pull the specific policy first, then read the relevant scope/covered-services sections and check for any amendments before answering.I found that Clinical Coverage Policy 5B is **Orthotics & Prosthetics**, not a chiropractic-services policy. Next I’m reading the actual description and non-covered sections, and checking whether this policy has been amended.The policy text confirms 5B is about orthotics and prosthetics, and I don’t see any direct amendment replacing it. I’m going to read one covered-services section as well so I can answer the “does it cover chiropractic services” question based on both scope and coverage text.**No.** NC Medicaid does **not** cover chiropractic services **under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B**, because **Policy 5B is the Orthotics & Prosthetics policy**, not a chiropractic-services policy.

### Why
The document returned for **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B** is **“Orthotics & Prosthetics.”** See: [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

The sections I reviewed describe coverage for **orthotic and prosthetic devices**, not chiropractic treatment:

- **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B, Section 3.2.1 — “Specific criteria covered by Medicaid”** states that covered items are orthotics and prosthetics that are ordered by a physician, PA, or NP and are medically necessary. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)
- **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B, Section 4.0 — “When the Procedure, Product, or Service Is Not Covered”** says the service is not covered if the beneficiary does not meet the criteria in Sections 2.0 and 3.0, among other reasons. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

### Bottom line
If your question is specifically **whether chiropractic services are covered under CCP 5B**, the answer is **no** — **5B governs orthotics and prosthetics, not chiropractic care**.

I also checked for amendments to Policy 5B and did not find any amendment replacing it as the authoritative document.

If you want, I can next look up **whether NC Medicaid covers chiropractic services at all**, and if so, under **which policy or benefit category**.
